full_list.title_en: Low-barrier-height Hf₁-xZrₓO₂ ferroelectric tunnel junctions with large ON-state currents
full_list.title_zh: 具有大导通电流的低势垒高度 Hf₁-xZrₓO2 铁电隧道结
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.33495v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ferroelectric tunnel junctions (FTJs) hold great promise for nonvolatile memory, neuromorphic computing, and other applications. Hf₁-xZrₓO₂ (HZO) has become a leading candidate for the tunnel barrier due primarily to its compatibility with CMOS technology. Recent advances on HZO based FTJs have highlighted the importance of understanding the electrical transport through a ferroelectric tunnel barrier for fulfilling the technological promises of FTJs. In this paper we report investigation of HZO FTJs featuring a barrier of ultrathin HZO (≤5nm) measured down to a temperature of 2 K. Direct quantum tunneling was found to dominate at low temperatures, along with contributions from trap-assisted tunneling. As the temperature increases, conduction by thermal activation takes over. We developed a minimal model that accounts for all experimental observations, revealing a barrier height significantly lower than that of the band alignment picture, an unexpected finding attributable to the emergence of a shallow trap band. This finding reveals a previously unexplored pathway toward simultaneously achieving large ON-state currents, high tunnel electroresistance and improved temperature stability for the high-speed memory applications of FTJs.
full_list.abstract_zh: 铁电隧道结 (FTJ) 在非易失性存储器、神经形态计算和其他应用中具有广阔的前景。 Hf₁-xZrₓO2 (HZO) 已成为隧道势垒的主要候选者，这主要是由于它与 CMOS 技术的兼容性。基于 HZO 的 FTJ 的最新进展凸显了了解通过铁电隧道势垒的电传输对于实现 FTJ 技术承诺的重要性。在本文中，我们报告了对 HZO FTJ 的研究，其特点是在低至 2 K 的温度下测量了超薄 HZO (≤5 nm) 势垒。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 铁电隧道结 (FTJ) 在非易失性存储器、神经形态计算和其他应用中具有广阔的前景。 Hf₁-xZrₓO2 (HZO) 已成为隧道势垒的主要候选者，这主要是由于它与 CMOS 技术的兼容性。基于 HZO 的 FTJ 的最新进展凸显了了解通过铁电隧道势垒的电传输对于实现 FTJ 技术承诺的重要性。在本文中，我们报告了对 HZO FTJ 的研究，其特点是在低至 2 K 的温度下测量了超薄 HZO (≤5 nm) 势垒。发现直接量子隧道效应在低温下占主导地位，同时陷阱辅助隧道效应也有贡献。随着温度升高，热激活传导开始发挥作用。我们开发了一个最小模型来解释所有实验观察结果，揭示了势垒高度明显低于能带对准图的高度，这是一个意外的发现，归因于浅陷阱带的出现。这一发现揭示了一条以前未探索过的途径，可以同时实现 FTJ 高速存储器应用的大导通电流、高隧道电阻和改进的温度稳定性。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。

full_list.title_en: Magnetization, susceptibility, and entanglement entropy in antiferromagnetic star-shaped homometallic tetranuclear and pentanuclear Cu(II) complexes
full_list.title_zh: 反铁磁星形同金属四核和五核 Cu(II) 配合物中的磁化强度、磁化率和纠缠熵
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.34281v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a theoretical investigation of the magnetization, magnetic susceptibility, and quantum entanglement entropy in antiferromagnetic star-shaped tetranuclear (Cu₄) and pentanuclear (Cu₅) Cu(II) clusters, motivated by experimentally realized molecular spin systems. In both cases, the study presents a discussion of the comparison between experimental data and theoretical analytical calculations of magnetic susceptibility as a function of temperature. The correlation between magnetization jumps and magnetic susceptibility peaks, along with the presence of entanglement entropy plateaus as a function of external magnetic fields, is analyzed in the low-temperature regime. Overall, the results demonstrate that the cluster size, geometry, and interaction anisotropy play a crucial role in shaping both the thermodynamic and the entanglement properties. In addition, the study is based on antiferromagnetic Heisenberg spin Hamiltonians, with the inclusion of the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在实验实现的分子自旋系统的推动下，我们对反铁磁星形四核 (Cu₄) 和五核 (Cu₅) Cu(II) 簇中的磁化强度、磁化率和量子纠缠熵进行了理论研究。在这两种情况下，该研究都讨论了磁化率随温度变化的实验数据和理论分析计算之间的比较。在低温状态下分析了磁化跃迁和磁化率峰值之间的相关性，以及作为外部磁场函数的纠缠熵平台的存在。总体而言，结果表明簇尺寸、几何形状和相互作用各向异性在塑造热力学和纠缠性质方面发挥着至关重要的作用。

full_list.title_en: Magnons in solids with correlated atomic and nanoscale disorder
full_list.title_zh: 具有相关原子和纳米级无序的固体中的磁振子
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.34926v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Atomic defects and disorder affect both the microscopic magnon excitations and the macroscopic physical properties of real-world magnetic materials. The rationalization of this relation has hitherto remained elusive, because of the intertwined challenges of simulating with quantum accuracy atomic- and nanoscale inhomogeneities and correlations, and their effect on the magnon spectral function determining observables such as spin stiffness. Here, we introduce a theoretical and computational framework to address these challenges. First, we develop the Coupled Optimization of SpIN Environment (COSINE) algorithm for efficiently relaxing the atomic structure and magnetic configuration of a solid with defects or disorder to a local energy minimum. Then, we discuss how to efficiently obtain exchange interactions accounting for local compositional, structural, and magnetic-moment inhomogeneities. Finally, we develop a paraunitary unfolding approach for Bogoliubov bosons, which allows us to predict the magnon spectral function in materials with any magnetic order, including systems with canting and full, partial, or no magnetic-moment compensation. We showcase our approach in a representative defective ferrimagnet for generality, and then combine it with state-of-the-art spin-informed machine-learning potentials to quantitatively predict how nonuniformities in the spatial distribution of vacancy defects control blurring of effective magnon bandstructures.
full_list.abstract_zh: 原子缺陷和无序会影响微观磁振子激发和现实世界磁性材料的宏观物理性质。迄今为止，这种关系的合理化仍然难以捉摸，因为以量子精度模拟原子和纳米尺度的不均匀性和相关性及其对确定自旋刚度等可观测值的磁振子谱函数的影响是相互交织的挑战。在这里，我们介绍一个理论和计算框架来应对这些挑战。首先，我们开发了 SpIN 环境耦合优化 (COSINE) 算法，用于有效地将具有缺陷或无序的固体的原子结构和磁构型放松到局部能量最小值。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 原子缺陷和无序会影响微观磁振子激发和现实世界磁性材料的宏观物理性质。迄今为止，这种关系的合理化仍然难以捉摸，因为以量子精度模拟原子和纳米尺度的不均匀性和相关性及其对确定自旋刚度等可观测值的磁振子谱函数的影响是相互交织的挑战。在这里，我们介绍一个理论和计算框架来应对这些挑战。首先，我们开发了 SpIN 环境耦合优化 (COSINE) 算法，用于有效地将具有缺陷或无序的固体的原子结构和磁构型放松到局部能量最小值。然后，我们讨论如何有效地获得考虑局部成分、结构和磁矩不均匀性的交换相互作用。最后，我们为博戈柳博夫玻色子开发了一种准统一展开方法，该方法使我们能够预测具有任何磁序的材料中的磁振子谱函数，包括具有倾斜和完全、部分或无磁矩补偿的系统。我们在具有代表性的缺陷亚铁磁体中展示了我们的方法，以实现通用性，然后将其与最先进的自旋信息机器学习势相结合，以定量预测空位缺陷空间分布的不均匀性如何控制有效磁振子能带结构的模糊。

full_list.title_en: Mode-resolved spin-wave spectroscopy by a single paramagnetic center
full_list.title_zh: 单一顺磁中心的模式分辨自旋波谱
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.34484v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate mode-resolved ferromagnetic resonance (FMR) spectroscopy using optically detected magnetic resonance (ODMR) of a single nitrogen-vacancy (NV) center in (111)-oriented diamond. A two-tone drive couples the magnetization dynamics to the NV spin resonance via the magnon Kerr effect. We show that the NV can detect the static stray field produced by this effect down to precession cone angles θ approx SI1degree, providing a generic scheme to measure the linear FMR spectrum with the spatial resolution of an atomic-size probe. We validate the approach on a normally magnetized yttrium iron garnet (YIG) microdisk, resolving its intrinsic quantized spin-wave modes. Scanning the probe across the surface, we map the spatial profile of the modes and find quantitative agreement with analytical models.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们使用 (111) 取向金刚石中单个氮空位 (NV) 中心的光学检测磁共振 (ODMR) 演示了模式分辨铁磁共振 (FMR) 光谱。双音驱动通过磁振子克尔效应将磁化动力学与 NV 自旋共振耦合。我们证明，NV 可以检测到由这种效应产生的静态杂散场，其进动锥角 θ 约为 SI1 度，提供了一种通用方案，以原子尺寸探针的空间分辨率来测量线性 FMR 频谱。我们在正常磁化的钇铁石榴石（YIG）微盘上验证了该方法，解析了其固有的量子化自旋波模式。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《单一顺磁中心的模式分辨自旋波谱》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Orientation-Dependent Universality of Spin-Conductance Fluctuations in d-Wave Altermagnets
full_list.title_zh: d 波交变磁体中自旋电导涨落的方向相关普遍性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.19793v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Universal conductance fluctuations reflect the symmetry and geometry of phase-coherent transport. However, it remains unclear whether crystal orientation relative to the device can tune fluctuation plateaus in spin-conserving altermagnets. Here, using quantum transport simulations of a two-dimensional d-wave altermagnet with scalar disorder, we show that crystal orientation tunes longitudinal and spin-Hall fluctuation plateaus while each spin sector remains in the orthogonal symmetry class. At intermediate disorder, tuning the crystal orientation toward the device diagonal weakens longitudinal spin-conductance fluctuations and enhances spin-Hall fluctuations. Both responses exhibit well-defined plateaus at the diagonal orientation, with amplitudes that depend only weakly on disorder and altermagnetic strength over the ranges studied. A variance decomposition shows that, at this orientation, increasing disorder drives the longitudinal spin-channel covariance toward zero, while the transverse covariance shifts from enhancing to suppressing the spin-Hall variance. Our findings suggest that spin-conductance fluctuations can probe transport anisotropy in altermagnets.
full_list.abstract_zh: 通用电导波动反映了相位相干传输的对称性和几何形状。然而，目前尚不清楚相对于器件的晶体取向是否可以调节自旋守恒交流磁体中的涨落平台。在这里，使用具有标量无序的二维 d 波交替磁体的量子输运模拟，我们表明晶体取向调整纵向和自旋霍尔涨落平台，而每个自旋扇区仍保持正交对称类。在中间无序状态下，将晶体取向调整为器件对角线会减弱纵向自旋电导波动并增强自旋霍尔波动。两种响应都在对角线方向上表现出明确的平台，其幅度仅微弱地依赖于所研究范围内的无序和交变磁场强度。

full_list.title_en: Probing the wave-vector gap in nanoscale magnonics
full_list.title_zh: 探测纳米级磁振子中的波矢间隙
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.15945v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Short-wavelength spin waves are central to miniaturizing magnonic devices and to studying exchange-dominated magnetization dynamics. Yet the wave-vector range between roughly 30 and 300 radians per micrometre has remained difficult to access experimentally, posing challenges for both excitation and detection. This Perspective reviews recent advances in emerging measurement techniques and discusses prospects for their future development. Optical and microwave techniques are restricted to the vicinity of the Brillouin-zone centre. Inelastic neutron, electron and resonant hard x-ray scattering cover the full Brillouin zone but lack the energy resolution needed for low-frequency magnons at intermediate wave vectors. This Perspective examines five emerging approaches that are beginning to close this gap: Mie-enhanced Brillouin light scattering, colour-centre magnetometry, magnon momentum microscopy, extreme-ultraviolet transient-grating spectroscopy, and time-resolved scanning transmission x-ray microscopy. For each, we discuss the physical principle, demonstrated capabilities, current limitations and prospects for development. Compared side by side, the techniques give complementary access to magnon frequencies, local stray fields, real-space dynamics and momentum-space distributions, and they differ in their sensitivity to coherent and incoherent excitations. We therefore discuss the main advantages and use cases of each technique and consider the practical requirements for addressing different scientific questions. We highlight opportunities for further development, including higher sensitivity, improved spatial and temporal resolution, and broader frequency and wave-vector coverage. Together, these advances could enable, for example, systematic studies of nonlinear magnon interactions at nanoscale wavelengths and investigations of emerging magnetic materials such as altermagnets.
full_list.abstract_zh: 短波长自旋波对于小型化磁振子器件和研究交换主导的磁化动力学至关重要。然而，每微米大约 30 到 300 弧度之间的波矢量范围仍然难以通过实验获得，这给激发和检测带来了挑战。本视角回顾了新兴测量技术的最新进展，并讨论了其未来发展的前景。光学和微波技术仅限于布里渊区中心附近。非弹性中子、电子和共振硬 X 射线散射覆盖整个布里渊区，但缺乏中波矢量低频磁振子所需的能量分辨率。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 短波长自旋波对于小型化磁振子器件和研究交换主导的磁化动力学至关重要。然而，每微米大约 30 到 300 弧度之间的波矢量范围仍然难以通过实验获得，这给激发和检测带来了挑战。本视角回顾了新兴测量技术的最新进展，并讨论了其未来发展的前景。光学和微波技术仅限于布里渊区中心附近。非弹性中子、电子和共振硬 X 射线散射覆盖整个布里渊区，但缺乏中波矢量低频磁振子所需的能量分辨率。本视角研究了五种正在开始缩小这一差距的新兴方法：米氏增强布里渊光散射、色心磁力测量、磁振子动量显微镜、极紫外瞬态光栅光谱和时间分辨扫描透射 X 射线显微镜。对于每一个，我们都讨论了物理原理、展示的功能、当前的局限性和发展前景。并排比较时，这些技术可以互补地获取磁振子频率、局部杂散场、实空间动力学和动量空间分布，并且它们对相干和非相干激励的敏感性不同。因此，我们讨论每种技术的主要优点和用例，并考虑解决不同科学问题的实际要求。我们强调进一步发展的机会，包括更高的灵敏度、改进的空间和时间分辨率以及更广泛的频率和波矢量覆盖范围。总之，这些进步可以实现纳米级波长下非线性磁振子相互作用的系统研究以及交流磁体等新兴磁性材料的研究。

full_list.title_en: Quantum-centric assessment of saturated ferromagnetism beyond the flat-band limit
full_list.title_zh: 超越平带极限的饱和铁磁性的量子中心评估
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.34204v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Saturated ferromagnetism has been proven for every on-site repulsion U > 0 in Hubbard models with a flat lowest band, and the interaction required for it grows with the band width W when the band becomes dispersive. We study the dispersive case at quarter filling by quantum-selected configuration interaction and sample-based quantum diagonalization with IBM Quantum's Heron processors, focusing on the quantized square of the total spin of the computed states. We treat a sawtooth chain of 16 unit cells on 64 qubits, whose full configuration space of 1.1× 10¹⁴ determinants exceeds that of one of the largest full configuration interaction calculations, and obtain the stability diagram of saturated ferromagnetism on the decorated square lattice in the plane of U and W. For the chain, a subspace of only 3× 10⁻⁵ of the full configuration space gives a state with more than 97% of its weight in the sector of maximal spin. For the decorated square lattice of 4× 3 unit cells on 48 qubits, the computed states in subspaces of less than 1% of the full configuration space switch from low-spin states to nearly fully polarized states at U simeq 2W. The calculations also give a rigorous lower bound of 1.9W on the critical interaction of the 4× 3 lattice.

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《超越平带极限的饱和铁磁性的量子中心评估》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Rotational Phonons Activated by Magnetism as a Key Ingredient of Cuprate Physics
full_list.title_zh: 磁性激活的旋转声子是铜酸盐物理的关键成分
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2602.21438v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Circularly polarized lattice vibrations carry angular momentum and can link lattice dynamics to collective responses in strongly correlated materials, particularly cuprate superconductors. Angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) reveals ubiquitous quasiparticle "kinks" near ~70 and ~40 meV in cuprates, often accompanied by peak-dip-hump (PDH) features, indicating strong coupling between electrons and low-energy bosonic excitations. However, the relevant phonon modes and the role of circularly polarized vibrations in these spectral anomalies remain largely elusive. Here, we investigate electron-phonon coupling (EPC) in hole-doped infinite-layer CaCuO2 at four selective hole dopings (12.5%-56.25%) using the Strongly Constrained and Appropriately Normed (SCAN) density functional with explicit magnetic interactions. At 25% doping, the magnetic phase exhibits substantially stronger EPC (lambda ~ 0.5), five times that of the nonmagnetic phase, producing kinks and PDH features over 40-80 meV, with self-energy magnitudes comparable to experiment. Oxygen rotational phonons dominate the coupling over 50-65 meV, while breathing modes play a lesser role; the rotational modes emerge exclusively in the magnetic phase. At 37.5% doping, lambda increases to ~1.6 due to strong coupling of low-frequency phonons near the Fermi-surface nesting wave vector, whereas at 56.25%, where Cu magnetic moments vanish, lambda decreases to ~0.4. The rotational modes carry staggered angular momentum that cancels in the unperturbed lattice; a time-reversal-breaking gyrotropic coupling on Cu sites lifts this cancellation, yielding a finite phonon thermal Hall conductivity. Our findings establish magnetism-enhanced EPC as an important ingredient of cuprate physics and identify rotational oxygen phonons as relevant to spectral anomalies, superconductivity, and the pseudogap thermal Hall effect.

full_list.title_en: Spin superfluid transport of magnons in altermagnetic insulators
full_list.title_zh: 交变磁绝缘体中磁振子的自旋超流体传输
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.33294v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the spin superfluidity for Lieb and inverse Lieb lattices in altermagnets, which enables coherent transport of spin angular momentum carried by the phase of an easy-plane Néel order. The easy-plane anisotropy supplies the U(1) platform, while the nonrelativistic spin splitting generates sublattice-alternating exchange imbalance with B₁g symmetry. Via a continuum theory and Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert simulations, we find that the Goldstone mode becomes quadratic at the critical stability boundary. An axial phase gradient transfers phase-channel spectral weight to the gapped mode, whereas a diagonal flow leaves these signatures absent. The spin superfluid exhibits momentum-space anisotropy due to the chiral-splitting magnon dispersion, while strong fields or elevated temperatures suppress phase coherence. Accounting for the contribution of thermal magnons at the interface, we present that the critical spin flow varies with the injection angle under the altermagnetic crystal-field effects. The spin-superfluid decay length scales with the interfacial spin-mixing conductance, which can be measured by the spin Hall magnetoresistance and spin Seebeck effect. Our findings establish altermagnetic insulators, particularly La₂O₃FeMnSe₂, as promising platforms for low-dissipation spin transport.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们研究了交流磁体中利布晶格和逆利布晶格的自旋超流性，这使得易平面尼尔阶的相位所携带的自旋角动量能够进行相干传输。易平面各向异性提供了 U(1) 平台，而非相对论性自旋分裂则产生具有 B₁g 对称性的亚晶格交替交换不平衡。通过连续介质理论和 Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert 模拟，我们发现 Goldstone 模式在临界稳定边界处变成二次型。轴向相位梯度将相位通道谱权重转移到间隙模式，而对角线流则不存在这些特征。

full_list.title_en: Time-Dependent Classical and Quantum Integrability in Sigma Models: From the λ-Model to the Perturbed SU(2)₁ WZW Model
full_list.title_zh: Σ模型中的时间相关经典可积性和量子可积性：从λ模型到微扰SU(2)₁ WZW模型
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2605.05111v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Using the Hamiltonian formulation of the λ-model with time-dependent coupling, we compare classical Lax and quantum integrability in the isotropic current-current deformation of the SU(2)₁ Wess-Zumino-Witten (WZW) model. From the classical WZW current algebra at fixed level, we derive equations of motion for the coupled left- and right-moving currents and construct a generalized Lax connection whose flatness fixes the integrable time-dependent coupling. Equal-time Lax-matrix Poisson brackets take the generalized Maillet form, and the r/s kernels satisfy the extended classical Yang-Baxter relation. A coupling redefinition and time reparametrization relate it to the λ-model with local couplings. At level one, non-Abelian bosonization identifies the deformed model with the interacting isospin sector of the chiral-invariant SU(2) Gross-Neveu model. In its exact generalized Bethe ansatz (GBA) solution, the quantum Yang-Baxter equation constrains the time-dependent coupling. In the universal weak-coupling regime, it shares the leading inverse-affine time dependence imposed by classical Lax flatness of the λ-model. This common weak-coupling equation coincides with the one-loop renormalization-group equation of the static model, with time identified with the logarithm of the UV cutoff. Periodic boundary conditions in the GBA yield the quantum Knizhnik-Zamolodchikov equations, whose solution gives an exact many-body wavefunction admitting a Yang-Yang representation at any nonzero drive rate. In the slow-drive limit, dynamical dimensional transmutation generates an isospin mass gap decaying exponentially in time on the decreasing-coupling branch, while in the fast-drive limit the isospin sector approaches the SU(2)₁ WZW UV fixed point. We also compare classical and quantum integrability of higher-level WZW and noncompact-group sigma models.

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Σ模型中的时间相关经典可积性和量子可积性：从λ模型到微扰SU(2)₁ WZW模型》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Transverse Shifts Driven by Geometric Orbital Torque in Altermagnets
full_list.title_zh: 交变磁体中几何轨道扭矩驱动的横向位移
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.34665v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Anomalous transverse shifts in interface reflection are conventionally attributed to spin-orbit coupling or its pseudospin analogue. Here, we uncover a distinct geometric mechanism driven solely by an orbital torque arising from Fermi-surface anisotropy. During total reflection, an incident wave packet penetrates the anisotropic transmitted medium as an evanescent wave. There, the broken rotational symmetry about the interface normal exerts an orbital torque, and the accumulated angular impulse---the product of the torque and the dwell time---leads to a transverse spatial shift. Applying this mechanism to altermagnets without spin-orbit coupling, we show that the orbital torque is odd in spin. As a consequence, the two spin channels are deflected to opposite sides of the incident plane, giving an intrinsic spatial spin separation in altermagnets. The shift also inherits the angular symmetry of the altermagnetic spin splitting and is strongly enhanced near the onset of total reflection. Our work thus uncovers a new mechanism for transverse shifts, predicts a novel spin separation effect in altermagnets, and offers a direct probe of the altermagnetic order.
full_list.abstract_zh: 界面反射中的异常横向位移通常归因于自旋轨道耦合或其赝自旋类似物。在这里，我们发现了一种独特的几何机制，该机制仅由费米表面各向异性产生的轨道扭矩驱动。在全反射期间，入射波包作为倏逝波穿透各向异性透射介质。在那里，关于界面法线的破缺旋转对称性施加了轨道扭矩，并且累积的角脉冲（扭矩和停留时间的乘积）导致横向空间移位。将这种机制应用于没有自旋轨道耦合的交流磁体，我们表明轨道扭矩在自旋中是奇数。因此，两个自旋通道偏转到入射平面的相对侧，从而在交变磁体中产生固有的空间自旋分离。

full_list.title_en: Tunable quantum metric driven nonlinear valley Hall effect in the PT-symmetric sliding antiferroelectric MoS₂
full_list.title_zh: PT 对称滑动反铁电 MoS2 中可调谐量子度量驱动的非线性谷霍尔效应
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.34116v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The quantum metric, the real part of a quantum geometric tensor, plays an important role in fundamental transport and optical responses of quantum materials. While net quantum metric effects are typically realized by breaking both time-reversal (T) and inversion (P) symmetries, valley-contrast mechanisms enable the probing of quantum geometry in centrosymmetric, nonmagnetic systems, revealing physical signatures beyond Berry curvature. Here, we design a four-layer MoS₂ platform that combines sliding antiferroelectric order with strain-induced C₃z breaking to realize a quantum metric driven nonlinear valley Hall effect (NVHE) under preserved P and T symmetries. Reversible interlayer sliding (ABBA ↔ BAAB) provides nonvolatile electrical control of the valley response. First-principles calculations reveal an outer-layer-dominated NVHE with tunable sign and magnitude. This symmetry-preserving, sliding-tunable strategy activates hidden quantum geometric phenomena in realistic two-dimensional materials and opens a clean pathway for tunable valleytronics and quantum information devices.
full_list.abstract_zh: 量子度量是量子几何张量的实部，在量子材料的基本输运和光学响应中发挥着重要作用。虽然净量子度量效应通常是通过打破时间反转（T）和反演（P）对称性来实现的，但谷对比机制使得能够探测中心对称、非磁性系统中的量子几何，揭示贝里曲率之外的物理特征。在这里，我们设计了一个四层 MoS2 平台，将滑动反铁电序与应变诱导的 C₃z 断裂相结合，以在保留 P 和 T 对称性的情况下实现量子度量驱动的非线性谷霍尔效应 (NVHE)。

full_list.title_en: Unveiling ferroelectricity in wafer-scale beta-phase In₂Se₃
full_list.title_zh: 揭示晶圆级 β 相 In2Se₃ 中的铁电性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.33405v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pushing ferroelectricity to the ultimate thickness limit is a central challenge for memory hardware, because conventional three-dimensional ferroelectrics degrade through depolarization and interfacial effects when thinned. Here we identify β-In₂Se₃, a van der Waals semiconductor regarded as centrosymmetric, as a host of bistable polar order arising from a picometre-scale distortion within each quintuple layer. The polar state has out-of-plane and in-plane components, is switched by a vertical electric field, and persists to the bilayer limit (~1.9 nm) with an estimated coercive field of 0.9 MV/cm and an apparent remanent polarization of 11.0 μC/cm². Films grown by metal-organic chemical vapor deposition on 2-inch wafers yield capacitor arrays with a switching-voltage spread below 5% across 100 devices, an endurance of 10⁷ cycles and a projected ten-year retention. Because the polar state coexists with a semiconducting gap, one film serves as both the switching layer of a capacitor and the channel of a ferroelectric semiconductor transistor.
full_list.abstract_zh: 将铁电体推向最终厚度极限是存储硬件面临的主要挑战，因为传统的三维铁电体在变薄时会因去极化和界面效应而退化。在这里，我们确定了β-In2Se₃，一种被认为是中心对称的范德华半导体，作为由每个五层内皮米级畸变产生的一系列双稳态极序。极性态具有面外和面内分量，通过垂直电场切换，并持续至双层极限（~1.9 nm），估计矫顽场为 0.9 MV/cm，表观剩余极化为 11.0 μC/cm²。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 将铁电体推向最终厚度极限是存储硬件面临的主要挑战，因为传统的三维铁电体在变薄时会因去极化和界面效应而退化。在这里，我们确定了β-In2Se₃，一种被认为是中心对称的范德华半导体，作为由每个五层内皮米级畸变产生的一系列双稳态极序。极性态具有面外和面内分量，通过垂直电场切换，并持续至双层极限（~1.9 nm），估计矫顽场为 0.9 MV/cm，表观剩余极化为 11.0 μC/cm²。通过金属有机化学气相沉积在 2 英寸晶圆上生长的薄膜，可生产出电容器阵列，其在 100 个器件上的开关电压分布低于 5%，耐用性为 10⁷ 周期，预计保持期为 10 年。由于极性态与半导体能隙共存，一层薄膜既可作为电容器的开关层，又可作为铁电半导体晶体管的沟道。
full_list.summary: 将铁电体推向最终厚度极限是存储硬件面临的主要挑战，因为传统的三维铁电体在变薄时会因去极化和界面效应而退化。在这里，我们确定了β-In2Se₃，一种被认为是中心对称的范德华半导体，作为由每个五层内皮米级畸变产生的一系列双稳态极序。极性态具有面外和面内分量，通过垂直电场切换，并持续至双层极限（~1.9 nm），估计矫顽场为 0.9 MV/cm，表观剩余极化为 11.0 μC/cm²。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”补充训练/验证集，再比较《揭示晶圆级 β 相 In2Se₃ 中的铁电性》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Quantum Entanglement Witnesses in Neutron-Proton Scattering and Radiative Capture
full_list.title_zh: 中子-质子散射和辐射捕获中的量子纠缠见证
full_list.abstract: We present a theoretical framework that relates quantum entanglement witnesses to low-energy neutron–proton scattering, to the structure of the deuteron, and to the radiative capture reaction n + p → d + γ. Three modern nucleon–nucleon potentialsare combined with density-matrix techniques and with the electromagnetic transition operators that govern the capture process. The witness operator is constructed on the physical Hilbert space Hd ⊗ Hγ, where the deuteron carries spin one and thephoton carries polarization two. We show that the operator is Hermitian, derive an explicit rescaling that enforces the separability bound analytically, and demonstrate through numerical examples how its sign separates separable from entangled states.The dependence of the witness on the tensor force is quantified through a dimensionless logarithmic measure and compared with the corresponding dependence of the quadrupole moment, the D-state probability, the magnetic moment and the asymptoticD/S ratio. Restricting attention to the two-nucleon sector, we find a negative expectation value of the rescaled witness at low energies, ⟨ W ⟩ = −0.42 ± 0.02 at thermal energy, which signals d–γ entanglement in the final state and, through the coherent electromagnetic transition, points to non-classical correlations generated in the np system within the present model. Calculated capture cross sections are compared with experimental data between 25meV and 10MeV; the Argonne v18 results reproduce the data at the few-percent level, with the best agreement (0.03%) at thermal energy and deviations of 1–3% at higher energies. We also compute the negativityof the dγ density matrix as an independent entanglement measure and find it consistent with the witness result. The limitations of the present two-nucleon treatment are discussed, and the ingredients that would be required before any statement aboutthe astrophysical S-factor can be defended are identified. Every quantitative result is presented either as a theoretical prediction or as an order-of-magnitude estimate, and the sources of model dependence and uncertainty are stated wherever they arise.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个理论框架，将量子纠缠证据与低能中子-质子散射、氘核结构以及辐射捕获反应 n + p → d + γ 联系起来。三种现代核子-核子势与密度矩阵技术以及控制捕获过程的电磁跃迁算子相结合。见证算子构建在物理希尔伯特空间 Hd ⊗ Hγ 上，其中氘核携带自旋一，光子携带偏振二。我们证明算子是埃尔米特算子，推导了一个明确的重新标度，以分析方式强制可分性界限，并通过数值例子证明了其符号如何将可分态与纠缠态分开。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一个理论框架，将量子纠缠证据与低能中子-质子散射、氘核结构以及辐射捕获反应 n + p → d + γ 联系起来。三种现代核子-核子势与密度矩阵技术以及控制捕获过程的电磁跃迁算子相结合。见证算子构建在物理希尔伯特空间 Hd ⊗ Hγ 上，其中氘核携带自旋一，光子携带偏振二。我们证明算子是埃尔米特算子，推导了一个明确的重新标度，以分析方式强制可分性界限，并通过数值例子证明了其符号如何将可分态与纠缠态分开。见证者对张量力的依赖性通过无量纲对数测量来量化，并与四极矩、D态概率、磁矩和渐近D/S比的相应依赖性进行比较。将注意力限制在双核子扇区上，我们发现低能下重新标度见证的负期望值，热能下⟨ W ⟩ = -0.42 ± 0.02，这表明最终状态下的 d-γ 纠缠，并通过相干电磁跃迁指向当前模型中 np 系统中生成的非经典相关性。计算的捕获截面与25meV和10MeV之间的实验数据进行比较； Argonne v18 结果以百分之几的水平重现了数据，在热能下具有最佳一致性 (0.03%)，在较高能量下偏差为 1-3%。我们还计算了 dγ 密度矩阵的负性作为独立的纠缠度量，并发现它与目击结果一致。讨论了目前双核处理的局限性，并确定了在捍卫任何有关天体物理 S 因子的陈述之前所需的成分。每个定量结果都以理论预测或数量级估计的形式呈现，并且模型依赖性和不确定性的来源无论何时出现都被说明。

full_list.title_en: Computational Study of Water Adsorption and Dissociative Mechanisms Impacting g-C3N4's Optical and Electronic Properties
full_list.title_zh: 影响 g-C3N4 光学和电子性能的水吸附和解离机制的计算研究
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2607.26667v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In the quest for sustainable energy solutions, water splitting emerges as a crucial process for generating clean hydrogen a versatile and renewable fuel essential for energy storage, emissions reduction, and achieving sustainability goals. This study employs a comprehensive computational approach, utilizing atomistic simulations to systematically investigate the effects of water absorption on the electronic and optical properties of g-C3N4 nanosheets. Our methodology integrates ab initio computations grounded in density functional theory (DFT), which allows for a detailed characterization of the nanosheet and serves as a benchmark for self-consistent charge density functional tight binding (SCC-DFTB) simulations. This approach provides valuable insights into the behavior of the nanosheet under the influence of absorbed OH and H2O molecules by considering calculated parameters for photocatalytic efficiency. Additionally, we extend our investigation to classical molecular dynamics simulations within the ReaxFF framework, modeling the emission of multiple H2O molecules and assessing the subsequent rate of H2 evolution. A key finding of our study reveals that the dissociation of H2O into HO and O molecules significantly enhances both the optical absorbance and conductance of the nanosheet compared to its pristine state. These results underscore the potential of g-C3N4 nanosheets as effective materials for water splitting applications.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在寻求可持续能源解决方案的过程中，水分解成为产生清洁氢气的关键过程，而清洁氢气是能源存储、减少排放和实现可持续发展目标所必需的多功能可再生燃料。本研究采用综合计算方法，利用原子模拟系统地研究吸水率对 g-C3N4 纳米片电子和光学性质的影响。我们的方法集成了基于密度泛函理论 (DFT) 的从头计算，它允许对纳米片进行详细表征，并作为自洽电荷密度泛函紧密结合 (SCC-DFTB) 模拟的基准。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 在寻求可持续能源解决方案的过程中，水分解成为产生清洁氢气的关键过程，而清洁氢气是能源存储、减少排放和实现可持续发展目标所必需的多功能可再生燃料。本研究采用综合计算方法，利用原子模拟系统地研究吸水率对 g-C3N4 纳米片电子和光学性质的影响。我们的方法集成了基于密度泛函理论 (DFT) 的从头计算，它允许对纳米片进行详细表征，并作为自洽电荷密度泛函紧密结合 (SCC-DFTB) 模拟的基准。该方法通过考虑光催化效率的计算参数，为了解纳米片在吸收的 OH 和 H2O 分子影响下的行为提供了有价值的见解。此外，我们将研究扩展到 ReaxFF 框架内的经典分子动力学模拟，对多个 H2O 分子的发射进行建模并评估随后的 H2 演化速率。我们研究的一个重要发现表明，与原始状态相比，H2O 解离为 H2O 和 O 分子显着增强了纳米片的光学吸光度和电导。这些结果强调了 g-C3N4 纳米片作为水分解应用的有效材料的潜力。
full_list.summary: 在寻求可持续能源解决方案的过程中，水分解成为产生清洁氢气的关键过程，而清洁氢气是能源存储、减少排放和实现可持续发展目标所必需的多功能可再生燃料。本研究采用综合计算方法，利用原子模拟系统地研究吸水率对 g-C3N4 纳米片电子和光学性质的影响。我们的方法集成了基于密度泛函理论 (DFT) 的从头计算，它允许对纳米片进行详细表征，并作为自洽电荷密度泛函紧密结合 (SCC-DFTB) 模拟的基准。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：分子动力学与有限温度轨迹、密度泛函理论和电子结构计算。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《影响 g-C3N4 光学和电子性能的水吸附和解离机制的计算研究》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: The Symmetry Budget: How Much Group Structure Should a Network Architecture Assume?
full_list.title_zh: 对称预算：网络架构应采用多少组结构？
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.33169v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A network architecture is, in large part, a symmetry assumption: convolution ties weights across translations, attention ties them across permutations, and a fully connected layer ties nothing. When the data are only approximately symmetric, tying trades approximation error against estimation error, and the right amount of tying is a property of the dataset, not of the architecture alone. We study this trade-off in an exactly solvable model: linear maps on signals over the cyclic group Z_d, with architectures indexed by the subgroup lattice of Z_d, so that a single integer k mid d interpolates between an unconstrained layer (k=1, d² parameters) and a fully equivariant one (k=d, d parameters). We derive the finite-sample excess risk in closed form, show that for a generic symmetry defect the leading-order risk is affine in 1/k, and prove that intermediate architectures are then never strictly optimal: the lattice collapses to an all-or-nothing choice with phase boundary n^star = σ² d(d-1)/ε². Structured defects break this collapse and restore interior optima, and we give a closed-form defect profile for a graded defect. Measurements agree with the theory on 60/60 cells of a (ε,n) phase diagram and 48/48 cells of a second phase diagram at d=16, recover the predicted exponent as -1.92 against -2, and exhibit the predicted k^star: 12 → 4 → 1 ladder under graded defects; a two-layer nonlinear control reproduces the crossover. We also characterize when the affine collapse survives for non-abelian groups.
full_list.abstract_zh: 网络架构在很大程度上是一种对称假设：卷积将权重跨翻译联系起来，注意力将权重跨排列联系起来，而全连接层则不联系任何东西。当数据仅近似对称时，绑定会用近似误差与估计误差进行交换，并且正确的绑定量是数据集的属性，而不仅仅是架构的属性。我们在一个完全可解的模型中研究这种权衡：循环群 Z_d 上信号的线性映射，其架构由 Z_d 的子群格索引，以便单个整数 k mid d 在无约束层（k=1，d²参数）和完全等变层（k=d，d 参数）之间插值。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合。从摘要能确认的线索包括：等变神经网络与对称性保持表示，以及缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”补充训练/验证集，再比较《对称预算：网络架构应采用多少组结构？》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: OrbACE: Orbital and Atomic Cluster Expansion
full_list.title_zh: OrbACE：轨道和原子团簇扩展
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.33743v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate electronic-structure reference data are expensive, motivating interatomic potentials that learn effectively from limited training sets. We introduce OrbACE (Orbital and Atomic Cluster Expansion), a framework that supplements an E(3)-equivariant cluster-expansion backbone with inexpensive electronic-structure descriptors. On ANI-1x at the ωB97X/6-31G* level, its atom-centered variant, OrbACE-A, trained on 10,000 configurations and evaluated on 442,000 held-out configurations, achieves energy and force mean absolute errors of 3.16 meV/atom and 76 meV/angstrom in direct learning, compared with 9.61 meV/atom and 146 meV/angstrom for MACE with matched backbone settings. This reduces the energy error by a factor of three and approximately halves the force error. Its energy error is also below that of the best delta-corrected MACE baseline, 5.00 meV/atom, although its force error is slightly higher. Combining OrbACE-A with a Hartree-Fock delta baseline further reduces the errors to 1.48 meV/atom and 35 meV/angstrom. OrbACE-A builds atom- and pair-resolved invariants from a non-self-consistent extended-Hueckel model evaluated within the differentiable forward pass, yielding forces consistent with the predicted energy. The orbital variant, OrbACE-O, instead uses localized Hartree-Fock orbitals as graph nodes, with scalar and equivariant electronic descriptors. Its forces are evaluated at fixed descriptors, omitting their response to nuclear motion. In direct learning on ANI-1x, its energy error is approximately three times that of OrbACE-A. The three benchmarks considered (ANI-1x, revised MD17, and 3BPA) cover neutral, closed-shell, non-periodic molecules containing H, C, N, and O. Performance outside this domain remains to be established.
full_list.abstract_zh: 准确的电子结构参考数据非常昂贵，激发了从有限的训练集中有效学习的原子间势。我们引入了 OrbACE（轨道和原子簇扩展），这是一个用廉价的电子结构描述符补充 E(3) 等变簇扩展主干的框架。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 准确的电子结构参考数据非常昂贵，激发了从有限的训练集中有效学习的原子间势。我们引入了 OrbACE（轨道和原子簇扩展），这是一个用廉价的电子结构描述符补充 E(3) 等变簇扩展主干的框架。在 ωB97X/6-31G* 级别的 ANI-1x 上，其以原子为中心的变体 OrbACE-A 在 10,000 个配置上进行训练并在 442,000 个保留配置上进行评估，在直接学习中实现了 3.16 meV/原子和 76 meV/埃的能量和力平均绝对误差，而对于 9.61 meV/原子和 146 meV/埃MACE 具有匹配的主干设置。 This reduces the energy error by a factor of three and approximately halves the force error.尽管其力误差略高，但其能量误差也低于最佳 Delta 校正 MACE 基线 5.00 meV/原子。将 OrbACE-A 与 Hartree-Fock delta 基线相结合，进一步将误差降低至 1.48 meV/原子和 35 meV/埃。 OrbACE-A 根据在可微分前向传播中评估的非自洽扩展 Hueckel 模型构建原子和对解析不变量，产生与预测能量一致的力。 The orbital variant, OrbACE-O, instead uses localized Hartree-Fock orbitals as graph nodes, with scalar and equivariant electronic descriptors. Its forces are evaluated at fixed descriptors, omitting their response to nuclear motion.在ANI-1x上直接学习时，其能量误差约为OrbACE-A的三倍。所考虑的三个基准（ANI-1x、修订版 MD17 和 3BPA）涵盖包含 H、C、N 和 O 的中性、闭壳、非周期分子。该领域之外的性能仍有待确定。

full_list.implication: 对《OrbACE：轨道和原子团簇扩展》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: A microscopic continuum model for moiré transition metal dichalcogenides
full_list.title_zh: 莫尔过渡金属二硫化物的微观连续模型
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.34937v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Twisted transition metal dichalcogenides (tTMDs) have emerged as a fascinating platform for many-body phases --- displaying fractional Chern insulators and superconductivity as a function of doping. Here, we give a microscopic derivation of a continuum model which accurately describes their bandstructure across a range of twist angles with angle-independent parameters. This angle-independent description rests on retaining both the monolayer valence and conduction bands, which introduce tunnelling paths through AB-stacked regions; upon downfolding to the valence band, these paths supply a substantial twist-tunable contribution to the interlayer coupling. We show that the model is a perturbation of a chiral model with a magic angle, explaining the near-ideal quantum geometry of the moiré bands. The model further produces a strongly different orbital magnetic moment to the single-orbital theory --- predicting an anomalous Landau level slope --- and a redistribution of charge between the layers, modifying the moiré ferroelectric potential.
full_list.abstract_zh: 扭曲过渡金属二硫化物 (tTMD) 已成为多体相的一个令人着迷的平台——显示分数陈绝缘体和超导性作为掺杂的函数。在这里，我们给出了连续介质模型的微观推导，该模型通过与角度无关的参数准确地描述了它们在一系列扭转角度上的能带结构。这种与角度无关的描述依赖于保留单层价带和导带，这引入了穿过AB堆叠区域的隧道路径；当向下折叠到价带时，这些路径为层间耦合提供了显着的扭转可调贡献。我们证明该模型是具有魔角的手性模型的扰动，解释了莫尔带的近乎理想的量子几何结构。

full_list.title_en: A van der Waals photon-ratchet for enhancing spin defect emission and quantum sensing
full_list.title_zh: 用于增强自旋缺陷发射和量子传感的范德华光子棘轮
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2602.02256v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Spin defects in two-dimensional materials are promising platforms for quantum information technologies and nanoscale sensing. The negatively charged boron vacancy (VB-) in hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) is particularly attractive due to its sensitivity to temperature, magnetic fields, and pressure, but its application is limited by intrinsically weak photoluminescence (PL). Here we demonstrate a van der Waals heterostructure that enhances the PL intensity of VB- by up to 45x at 4 Kelvin while preserving compatibility with ultrathin optoelectronic platforms. A type-I band alignment at the PbI2-hBN interface facilitates efficient interlayer coupling to the defect, and strong spectral overlap supports fluorescence resonance energy transfer. Ab initio calculations indicate that this coupling enables a photon-ratcheting mechanism, in which optical absorption in PbI2 generates a nonlinear polarization that drives VB- excitation. This process is consistent with interlayer energy transfer while maintaining minimal electronic and spin hybridization and preserving optically detected magnetic resonance (ODMR) contrast. The heterostructure further exhibits improved sensitivity to external magnetic fields. These results establish a route for the enhancement of defect emission via interlayer optical coupling and introduce a general materials strategy for amplifying weak quantum defect signals in nanomaterials.
full_list.abstract_zh: 二维材料中的自旋缺陷是量子信息技术和纳米级传感的有前途的平台。六方氮化硼（hBN）中带负电的硼空位（VB-）由于其对温度、磁场和压力的敏感性而特别有吸引力，但其应用受到本质上较弱的光致发光（PL）的限制。在这里，我们展示了一种范德华异质结构，可将 VB- 的 PL 强度在 4 开尔文下增强高达 45 倍，同时保持与超薄光电平台的兼容性。 PbI2-hBN 界面处的 I 型能带排列有利于与缺陷的有效层间耦合，并且强光谱重叠支持荧光共振能量转移。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 二维材料中的自旋缺陷是量子信息技术和纳米级传感的有前途的平台。六方氮化硼（hBN）中带负电的硼空位（VB-）由于其对温度、磁场和压力的敏感性而特别有吸引力，但其应用受到本质上较弱的光致发光（PL）的限制。在这里，我们展示了一种范德华异质结构，可将 VB- 的 PL 强度在 4 开尔文下增强高达 45 倍，同时保持与超薄光电平台的兼容性。 PbI2-hBN 界面处的 I 型能带排列有利于与缺陷的有效层间耦合，并且强光谱重叠支持荧光共振能量转移。从头计算表明，这种耦合实现了光子棘轮机制，其中 PbI2 中的光学吸收产生驱动 VB 激发的非线性偏振。该过程与层间能量转移一致，同时保持最小的电子和自旋杂交并保持光学检测的磁共振（ODMR）对比度。该异质结构进一步表现出对外部磁场的改进的敏感性。这些结果建立了一条通过层间光耦合增强缺陷发射的途径，并引入了放大纳米材料中弱量子缺陷信号的通用材料策略。
full_list.summary: 二维材料中的自旋缺陷是量子信息技术和纳米级传感的有前途的平台。六方氮化硼（hBN）中带负电的硼空位（VB-）由于其对温度、磁场和压力的敏感性而特别有吸引力，但其应用受到本质上较弱的光致发光（PL）的限制。在这里，我们展示了一种范德华异质结构，可将 VB- 的 PL 强度在 4 开尔文下增强高达 45 倍，同时保持与超薄光电平台的兼容性。 PbI2-hBN 界面处的 I 型能带排列有利于与缺陷的有效层间耦合，并且强光谱重叠支持荧光共振能量转移。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《用于增强自旋缺陷发射和量子传感的范德华光子棘轮》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Collective relaxation dynamics and vitrification in hexatic smectic binary equimolar mixtures containing component with varying C₃F₇CH₂OCₘH₂ₘ- chain length
full_list.title_zh: 含有不同 C₃F₇CH2OCₘH2ₘ- 链长组分的六方近晶二元等摩尔混合物中的集体弛豫动力学和玻璃化
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.34286v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Differential scanning calorimetry, polarizing optical microscopy, and broadband dielectric spectroscopy are applied for investigation of phase transitions in equimolar binary mixtures consisting of the MHPOBC liquid crystal as one component and 3FmHPhH6 homologs as a second component with different C₃F₇CH₂OCₘH₂ₘ- chain length (m = 2-7). The paraelectric smectic A* - ferroelectric smectic C* - antiferroelectric smectic C_A* - hexatic smectic X_A* - glassy smectic X_A* sequence is observed for all mixtures. The appearance of the bond-orientational order in smectic X_A* is accompanied by an additional relaxation process Pₕₑₓ in dielectric spectra at the low-frequency side of the P_H phason, consistent with its assignment to bond-orientational fluctuations. The empirical exponential-power relationship is proposed for the ratio between the relaxation times of Pₕₑₓ and P_H. The behavior of the structural α-relaxation and secondary β-relaxation in smectic X_A* depends on the m parameter, changing from overlapping α and β processes for m = 2 to well-separated for m = 6, 7. A double glass transition is observed by calorimetry on heating for m = 5-7. The calorimetric glass transition temperature shows a composition-dependent correspondence with temperatures at which either the P_H or α-relaxation time reaches 100 s, suggesting that different relaxation processes may contribute to vitrification.

full_list.title_en: Crystal-Symmetry-Dependent Field-Free Superconducting Diode Effect in CoPt/Nb Heterostructures
full_list.title_zh: CoPt/Nb 异质结构中晶体对称性相关的无场超导二极管效应
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.33717v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Superconducting diodes convert nonreciprocal critical currents into current-polarity-selective switching between zero-resistance and resistive states. However, realizing the superconducting diode effect often requires complex device architectures and an external magnetic field to break spatial-inversion and time-reversal symmetry, substantially limiting its integration into cryogenic electronics and superconducting quantum circuits. Here, we demonstrate precise control of the field-free superconducting diode effect in epitaxial [111]-oriented A1-CoPt/Nb heterostructures. The critical-current asymmetry obeys the magnetic-point-group symmetry relation: it is finite along low-symmetry directions, suppressed along magnetic mirror axes, and reverses under either a 60deg in-plane rotation or reversal of the CoPt magnetization. The same threefold symmetry dependence is observed in field-free current-induced magnetization switching in A1-CoPt films, indicating a common crystallographic origin for the superconducting and normal-state transport responses. Current- and temperature-dependent second-harmonic transport measurements are consistent with vortex-mediated nonreciprocity arising from an orientation-dependent interfacial edge landscape. We further exploit the magnetization-dependent diode polarity for proof-of-concept superconducting readout of electrically written magnetic states. These results establish crystallographic symmetry as an effective degree of freedom for engineering the superconducting diode effect, expanding the accessible materials space and providing a practical route toward field-free superconducting electronics.
full_list.abstract_zh: 超导二极管将不可逆临界电流转换为零电阻和电阻状态之间的电流极性选择性切换。然而，实现超导二极管效应通常需要复杂的器件架构和外部磁场来打破空间反转和时间反转对称性，这大大限制了其与低温电子学和超导量子电路的集成。在这里，我们展示了外延[111]取向的A1-CoPt/Nb异质结构中无场超导二极管效应的精确控制。临界电流不对称性遵循磁点群对称关系：它沿着低对称性方向是有限的，沿着磁镜轴受到抑制，并且在 60 度面内旋转或 CoPt 磁化强度反转的情况下反转。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 超导二极管将不可逆临界电流转换为零电阻和电阻状态之间的电流极性选择性切换。然而，实现超导二极管效应通常需要复杂的器件架构和外部磁场来打破空间反转和时间反转对称性，这大大限制了其与低温电子学和超导量子电路的集成。在这里，我们展示了外延[111]取向的A1-CoPt/Nb异质结构中无场超导二极管效应的精确控制。临界电流不对称性遵循磁点群对称关系：它沿着低对称性方向是有限的，沿着磁镜轴受到抑制，并且在 60 度面内旋转或 CoPt 磁化强度反转的情况下反转。在 A1-CoPt 薄膜中的无场电流感应磁化转变中观察到相同的三重对称依赖性，表明超导和正常状态输运响应具有共同的晶体学起源。电流和温度相关的二次谐波传输测量与由方向相关的界面边缘景观引起的涡旋介导的非互易性一致。我们进一步利用磁化相关的二极管极性来验证电写入磁状态的超导读出。这些结果将晶体学对称性确立为设计超导二极管效应的有效自由度，扩大了可访问的材料空间，并为无场超导电子学提供了一条实用途径。

full_list.title_en: Electron exchange matters in electron spectroscopy
full_list.title_zh: 电子光谱中的电子交换很重要
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.33637v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electron energy-loss spectroscopy (EELS) conventionally considers classical Coulomb interactions between probe and material electrons, overlooking their fermionic exchange at relativistic energies. Here, we develop a relativistic theory of magnon EELS incorporating both magnetic dipole and electron exchange interactions. We show that the two channels leave distinguishable electron spin states, suppressing their interference in conventional EELS. However, spin-resolved detection erases this which-path information, revealing first-order interference despite the weak exchange amplitude. Remarkably, the same interference produces a left-right intensity asymmetry with a spin-polarized incident beam, without requiring outgoing-spin analysis. We demonstrate that this signal directly probes magnon angular momentum and distinguishes excitations of opposite handedness, opening a route to nanoscale measurements of chiral magnetic excitations.
full_list.abstract_zh: 电子能量损失谱（EELS）通常考虑探针和材料电子之间的经典库仑相互作用，忽略它们在相对论能量下的费米子交换。在这里，我们开发了一种结合磁偶极子和电子交换相互作用的磁振子 EELS 相对论理论。我们证明这两个通道留下了可区分的电子自旋态，从而抑制了它们对传统 EELS 的干扰。然而，自旋分辨检测消除了该路径信息，尽管交换幅度较弱，但仍揭示了一阶干扰。值得注意的是，相同的干涉会通过自旋偏振入射光束产生左右强度不对称，而无需进行出自自旋分析。

full_list.title_en: Electron--phonon interactions in a pseudo--atomic orbital basis: superconductivity, transport, spectroscopy and thermal emission from one interpolated vertex
full_list.title_zh: 赝原子轨道基础上的电子-声子相互作用：来自一个插值顶点的超导性、输运、光谱学和热发射
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.33473v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electron--phonon interactions govern superconductivity, electrical resistivity, optical absorption and electronic excitation lifetimes in solids. First--principles calculations require interpolating this coupling onto dense Brillouin--zone grids, traditionally using maximally localized Wannier functions that demand material--specific tuning. Here we show that a fixed basis of pseudo--atomic orbitals--automatically generated from pseudopotentials and implemented in the open--source code PAOFLOW captures the electron--phonon vertex with equivalent accuracy and no manual tuning. Computed from density--functional perturbation theory or displaced supercells, and incorporating long--range fields and spin--orbit coupling, the vertex matches established codes on identical inputs. We validate the method on lead, reproducing its phonon dispersion, superconducting gap, critical temperature, resistivity, photoemission kink and cyclotron masses, and on silicon, capturing phonon--assisted optical absorption, wafer emissivity and carrier mobilities. This parameter--free framework enables high--throughput, automated electron--phonon calculations across large materials databases.
full_list.abstract_zh: 电子-声子相互作用控制着固体中的超导性、电阻率、光吸收和电子激发寿命。第一原理计算需要将这种耦合插值到密集的布里渊区网格上，传统上使用需要特定材料调整的最大局部化万尼尔函数。在这里，我们展示了从赝势自动生成并在开源代码 PAOFLOW 中实现的赝原子轨道的固定基础，以同等精度捕获电子声子顶点，无需手动调整。根据密度泛函微扰理论或位移超晶胞计算，并结合长程场和自旋轨道耦合，顶点与相同输入上的既定代码相匹配。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 电子-声子相互作用控制着固体中的超导性、电阻率、光吸收和电子激发寿命。第一原理计算需要将这种耦合插值到密集的布里渊区网格上，传统上使用需要特定材料调整的最大局部化万尼尔函数。在这里，我们展示了从赝势自动生成并在开源代码 PAOFLOW 中实现的赝原子轨道的固定基础，以同等精度捕获电子声子顶点，无需手动调整。根据密度泛函微扰理论或位移超晶胞计算，并结合长程场和自旋轨道耦合，顶点与相同输入上的既定代码相匹配。我们在铅上验证了该方法，再现了其声子色散、超导间隙、临界温度、电阻率、光电发射扭结和回旋加速器质量，并在硅上验证了该方法，捕获了声子辅助光学吸收、晶片发射率和载流子迁移率。这种无参数框架可实现跨大型材料数据库的高通量、自动化电子声子计算。

full_list.title_en: Excited-state structure and photoluminescence of the M-center in Si
full_list.title_zh: Si 中 M 中心的激发态结构和光致发光
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.30790v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Color centers in silicon offer great possibilities for scalable quantum technologies. The M-center, proposed to originate from a carbon-hydrogen complex, offers telecommunications-band emission and a paramagnetic ground state similar to the T-center. Here, we report on photoluminescence lines in the vicinity of the M-center and investigate their properties, including their dependence on temperature, implantation fluence, implantation isotope, and annealing temperature. Three emission lines are observed that are blue-shifted by 1.1, 2.8 and 3.6 meV relative to the 761 meV zero phonon line of the M center. The 2.8 meV line exhibits negative thermal quenching with an activation energy of 1.5 meV, strengthening the assignment of the line to a second excited state of the M-center. However, the remaining blue-shifted emission lines, together with two additional red-shifted (4.7 and 6.4 meV) emission lines display normal thermal quenching, and are unaffected by an isotope shift of the implanted carbon atom (¹²C versus ¹³C implantation) and implantation fluence. Thus, they likely arise either from other defects with similar emission energies or from a perturbed configuration of the M-center.
full_list.abstract_zh: 硅中的色心为可扩展的量子技术提供了巨大的可能性。 M 中心被认为源自碳氢复合物，提供与 T 中心类似的电信频段发射和顺磁基态。在这里，我们报告了 M 中心附近的光致发光线并研究了它们的特性，包括它们对温度、注入注量、注入同位素和退火温度的依赖性。观察到三个发射线相对于 M 中心的 761 meV 零声子线蓝移 1.1、2.8 和 3.6 meV。 2.8 meV 线表现出负热猝灭，活化能为 1.5 meV，加强了该线对 M 中心第二激发态的分配。

full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Si 中 M 中心的激发态结构和光致发光》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Hidden Triakontadipole Order in the Triangular-Lattice Magnet CeMgAl₁₁O₁₉
full_list.title_zh: 三角晶格磁体 CeMgAl₁₁O₁₉ 中隐藏的 Triakontadipole 顺序
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.04845v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The absence of magnetic Bragg peaks and a broad excitation continuum are commonly recognized experimental features of a quantum spin liquid. The Ce-based triangular-lattice hexaaluminate CeMgAl₁₁O₁₉ exhibits both signatures, yet its effective model and ground state remain under debate. Experiments have variously suggested a quantum spin liquid, proximate umbrella point, and disorder-suppressed magnetic order. Here we trace these contradictions to an overlooked multipolar degree of freedom, and establish a dipole--triakontadipole XXZ model with Jₚₑᵣₚ simeq 0.65 K and J_c simeq -0.13 K via precision tensor-network calculations. The resulting planar triakontadipolar superfluid order is hidden from dipolar probes, explaining the absence of a magnetic Bragg peak in neutron scattering. The zero-field excitations separate into a low-energy triakontadipole wave and a broad higher-energy continuum. We further propose nuclear spin-lattice relaxation and spin-current experiments to probe the gapless excitations of this hidden triakontadipole superfluid. Our findings thus offer a hidden-order caveat for spin-liquid searches and provide a new platform for exploring high-rank multipolar physics in rare-earth triangular-lattice magnets.
full_list.abstract_zh: 不存在磁性布拉格峰和宽的激发连续体是量子自旋液体普遍公认的实验特征。 Ce基三角晶格六铝酸盐CeMgAl₁₁O₁₉表现出这两个特征，但其有效模型和基态仍存在争议。实验从不同角度提出了量子自旋液体、近似伞点和无序抑制磁序。在这里，我们将这些矛盾追溯到被忽视的多极自由度，并通过精密张量网络计算建立了 Jₚₑᵣₚ simeq 0.65 K 和 J_c simeq -0.13 K 的偶极子 - triakontadipole XXZ 模型。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 不存在磁性布拉格峰和宽的激发连续体是量子自旋液体普遍公认的实验特征。 Ce基三角晶格六铝酸盐CeMgAl₁₁O₁₉表现出这两个特征，但其有效模型和基态仍存在争议。实验从不同角度提出了量子自旋液体、近似伞点和无序抑制磁序。在这里，我们将这些矛盾追溯到被忽视的多极自由度，并通过精密张量网络计算建立了 Jₚₑᵣₚ simeq 0.65 K 和 J_c simeq -0.13 K 的偶极子 - triakontadipole XXZ 模型。由此产生的平面三孔二极超流体序对偶极探针来说是隐藏的，这解释了中子散射中不存在磁布拉格峰的原因。零场激发分为低能三触偶极波和广泛的高能连续谱。我们进一步提出核自旋晶格弛豫和自旋电流实验来探测这种隐藏的三康他偶极超流体的无间隙激发。因此，我们的发现为自旋液体搜索提供了隐藏序警告，并为探索稀土三角晶格磁体中的高阶多极物理提供了一个新平台。

full_list.title_en: Infrared-absorption magnetometry in a diamond nanocavity: demonstration and limits at the nanoscale
full_list.title_zh: 金刚石纳米腔中的红外吸收磁力测量：纳米尺度的演示和限制
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.33481v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Diamond quantum sensors promise both high spatial resolution and high sensitivity; however, conventional photoluminescence-based spin readout can be difficult to integrate efficiently. Infrared absorption by nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centres in diamond provides a promising alternative, although the sensitivity of compact absorption-based sensors is limited by the short optical interaction length between the probe field and the NV ensemble. To overcome this limitation, we demonstrate, for the first time, singlet-absorption magnetometry using spin-dense diamond nanocavities. By probing cavity modes near the 1042 nm NV singlet transition, we observe spin-dependent cavity transmission and perform cavity-enhanced magnetic field sensing. We further develop and experimentally validate a model that accurately predicts the spin-dependent cavity response, describes the optimal operating conditions, and identifies the practical limitations of different optically detected magnetic resonance modalities. Together, these results establish cavity-enhanced singlet absorption as a scalable readout mechanism for integrated diamond quantum sensors and provide a practical framework for engineering next-generation nanophotonic diamond quantum magnetometers.
full_list.abstract_zh: 金刚石量子传感器兼具高空间分辨率和高灵敏度；然而，传统的基于光致发光的自旋读出可能难以有效集成。金刚石中氮空位 (NV) 中心的红外吸收提供了一种有前途的替代方案，尽管基于紧凑吸收的传感器的灵敏度受到探测场和 NV 系综之间的短光学相互作用长度的限制。为了克服这一限制，我们首次展示了使用自旋致密金刚石纳米腔的单重态吸收磁力测量。通过探测 1042 nm NV 单重态跃迁附近的腔模式，我们观察到自旋相关的腔传输并执行腔增强磁场传感。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 金刚石量子传感器兼具高空间分辨率和高灵敏度；然而，传统的基于光致发光的自旋读出可能难以有效集成。金刚石中氮空位 (NV) 中心的红外吸收提供了一种有前途的替代方案，尽管基于紧凑吸收的传感器的灵敏度受到探测场和 NV 系综之间的短光学相互作用长度的限制。为了克服这一限制，我们首次展示了使用自旋致密金刚石纳米腔的单重态吸收磁力测量。通过探测 1042 nm NV 单重态跃迁附近的腔模式，我们观察到自旋相关的腔传输并执行腔增强磁场传感。我们进一步开发并通过实验验证了一个模型，该模型可以准确预测自旋相关的腔响应，描述最佳操作条件，并确定不同光学检测磁共振模态的实际局限性。总之，这些结果将腔增强单线态吸收确立为集成金刚石量子传感器的可扩展读出机制，并为设计下一代纳米光子金刚石量子磁力计提供了实用框架。

full_list.title_en: Magnetic Reconfiguration Controls Spin Splitting and Spin-Orbit-Coupled Responses in Compensated Magnets
full_list.title_zh: 磁重配置控制补偿磁体中的自旋分裂和自旋轨道耦合响应
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.34513v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Compensated magnets provide a versatile platform for spin-dependent electronic and transport phenomena. Here, we show that magnetic reconfiguration, i.e., selective reversal of local moments without changing the underlying crystal structure, can profoundly transform the nonrelativistic spin splitting and spin-orbit-coupled responses of spin-degenerate antiferromagnets (AFMs), altermagnets (AMs), and compensated ferrimagnets (cFIMs). Strikingly, magnetic configurations with nearly degenerate energies can exhibit qualitatively different spin-split band structures and anomalous Hall responses, allowing a small magnetic-energy scale to produce large changes in physical properties. Combining tight-binding models, oriented spin space group analysis, and first-principles calculations, we demonstrate that converting an AM configuration into cFIM states activates staggered onsite-potential contributions to spin splitting, complementing the anisotropic-hopping mechanism of AMs and removing symmetry-enforced degeneracies. Moreover, cFIM symmetry permits an anomalous Hall response at first order in spin-orbit coupling, in contrast to the higher-order or orientation-constrained responses of corresponding AM states. We demonstrate this regime in Mn2Mo3O8, one of 12 cFIM candidates identified in the MAGNDATA database, and further demonstrate its generality by designing cFIMs from collinear AFMs, exemplified by MnGeO3 and Co2Mo3O8. Our results establish magnetic reconfiguration as a powerful symmetry-guided strategy for dramatically reshaping electronic and transport responses in compensated magnets.
full_list.abstract_zh: 补偿磁体为自旋相关电子和传输现象提供了一个多功能平台。在这里，我们证明磁重构，即在不改变底层晶体结构的情况下选择性反转局部矩，可以深刻地改变自旋简并反铁磁体（AFM）、交流磁体（AM）和补偿亚铁磁体（cFIM）的非相对论自旋分裂和自旋轨道耦合响应。引人注目的是，具有近简并能量的磁性结构可以表现出性质不同的自旋分裂能带结构和反常霍尔响应，从而允许小的磁能尺度产生物理性质的大变化。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 补偿磁体为自旋相关电子和传输现象提供了一个多功能平台。在这里，我们证明磁重构，即在不改变底层晶体结构的情况下选择性反转局部矩，可以深刻地改变自旋简并反铁磁体（AFM）、交流磁体（AM）和补偿亚铁磁体（cFIM）的非相对论自旋分裂和自旋轨道耦合响应。引人注目的是，具有近简并能量的磁性结构可以表现出性质不同的自旋分裂能带结构和反常霍尔响应，从而允许小的磁能尺度产生物理性质的大变化。结合紧束缚模型、定向自旋空间群分析和第一原理计算，我们证明将 AM 配置转换为 cFIM 态会激活对自旋分裂的交错现场电位贡献，补充 AM 的各向异性跳跃机制并消除对称性强制的简并性。此外，cFIM 对称性允许自旋轨道耦合中的一阶异常霍尔响应，这与相应 AM 态的高阶或方向约束响应相反。我们在 Mn2Mo3O8（MAGNDATA 数据库中确定的 12 个 cFIM 候选者之一）中证明了这种机制，并通过从共线 AFM 设计 cFIM（以 MnGeO3 和 Co2Mo3O8 为例）进一步证明了其通用性。我们的结果将磁重构确立为一种强大的对称引导策略，可显着重塑补偿磁体中的电子和传输响应。
full_list.summary: 补偿磁体为自旋相关电子和传输现象提供了一个多功能平台。在这里，我们证明磁重构，即在不改变底层晶体结构的情况下选择性反转局部矩，可以深刻地改变自旋简并反铁磁体（AFM）、交流磁体（AM）和补偿亚铁磁体（cFIM）的非相对论自旋分裂和自旋轨道耦合响应。引人注目的是，具有近简并能量的磁性结构可以表现出性质不同的自旋分裂能带结构和反常霍尔响应，从而允许小的磁能尺度产生物理性质的大变化。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：第一性原理标注与结构优化，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《磁重配置控制补偿磁体中的自旋分裂和自旋轨道耦合响应》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Magnetically Guided Sequential Multi-Filler Alignment Enables Anisotropic Heat Pathways in Stretchable Composites for Soft Electronics
full_list.title_zh: 磁引导顺序多填料排列可实现软电子可拉伸复合材料中的各向异性热路径
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.33381v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Stretchable, skin-conformal electronics demand thermal interface materials that combine high through-plane heat transport with mechanical softness and lateral electrical insulation. In particle-filled composites, these requirements are typically antagonistic. Heat transport is governed not only by the intrinsic thermal conductivity of the fillers but, more critically, by thermal resistance at the interparticle interface. As the interparticle distance is reduced by increasing the particle content, mechanical reinforcement and in-plane electrical conductivity become unavoidable. The existing particle alignment processing strategies result in inefficient uncoupling of multifunctionality. Here, we present a hierarchical two-step process strategy to induce strong conductivity anisotropy in a soft composite. First, an align-before-blend process forms a scaffold of magnetically aligned nickel (Ni) microparticles in air before polymer infiltration. The absence of the viscous elastomer matrix during the particle alignment facilitates handling large amounts of particles, which assemble into highly ordered and densely packed vertical heat-conduction pathways. Second, a liquid metal (LM)/Ni mixture is infiltrated into the aligned scaffold to bridge interparticle gaps, minimizing interparticle thermal resistance. The composite reaches 7.5 W/(m K) through-plane thermal conductivity with lateral electrical conductivity below 10⁻¹² S/m and ultrasoft mechanical compliance (approximately 160 kPa), enabling coupling layers in thermoelectric generators and finger-mounted heat-spreading pads for wearable technologies.
full_list.abstract_zh: 可拉伸、贴合皮肤的电子产品需要热界面材料，将高平面热传输与机械柔软性和横向电绝缘性结合起来。在颗粒填充复合材料中，这些要求通常是相互矛盾的。热传输不仅受填料固有导热率的影响，更重要的是受颗粒间界面热阻的影响。由于通过增加颗粒含量来减小颗粒间距离，因此机械增强和面内导电性变得不可避免。现有的粒子排列处理策略导致多功能性的低效解耦。在这里，我们提出了一种分层两步工艺策略，以在软复合材料中诱导强电导率各向异性。

full_list.title_en: Many-Anyon Braiding in Non-Abelian Fractional Quantum Hall Effect with Hybrid Monte Carlo Simulation
full_list.title_zh: 非阿贝尔分数量子霍尔效应中的多任意子编织与混合蒙特卡罗模拟
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.17424v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We use the hybrid Monte Carlo method to efficiently compute the many-anyon non-Abelian braiding matrices for different Moore-Read quasiholes braiding schemes. Using both a traditional two-anyon braiding scheme and a newly proposed braiding scheme based on global rotation, we approximate the non-Abelian characteristic length of Moore-Read quasiholes around 2.8 times the magnetic length. We also apply this method to braiding schemes involving six anyons and explicitly show that the well-known ``even-odd effect'' can be flipped by tuning electrostatic potentials. This phenomenon emphasizes the importance of accounting for all anyons within a non-Abelian system, even if the braiding involves only several anyons locally. Our results are relevant to the experimental realization of non-Abelian physics in fractional quantum Hall and other analogous systems, including the fast-growing field of fractional quantum anomalous Hall states in moiré materials.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们使用混合蒙特卡罗方法来有效计算不同 Moore-Read 准空穴编织方案的多任意子非阿贝尔编织矩阵。使用传统的双任意子编织方案和新提出的基于全局旋转的编织方案，我们将摩尔-里德准空穴的非阿贝尔特征长度近似为磁长度的2.8倍。我们还将这种方法应用于涉及六个任意子的编织方案，并明确表明可以通过调整静电势来翻转众所周知的“偶奇效应”。这种现象强调了考虑非阿贝尔系统内所有任意子的重要性，即使编织仅涉及局部任意子。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用混合蒙特卡罗方法来有效计算不同 Moore-Read 准空穴编织方案的多任意子非阿贝尔编织矩阵。使用传统的双任意子编织方案和新提出的基于全局旋转的编织方案，我们将摩尔-里德准空穴的非阿贝尔特征长度近似为磁长度的2.8倍。我们还将这种方法应用于涉及六个任意子的编织方案，并明确表明可以通过调整静电势来翻转众所周知的“偶奇效应”。这种现象强调了考虑非阿贝尔系统内所有任意子的重要性，即使编织仅涉及局部任意子。我们的结果与分数量子霍尔和其他类似系统中非阿贝尔物理的实验实现相关，包括莫尔材料中快速增长的分数量子反常霍尔态领域。

full_list.title_en: Measuring the Roughness of Quasi-Circular Interfaces at Finite Resolution
full_list.title_zh: 以有限分辨率测量准圆形界面的粗糙度
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.34556v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Interface roughness characterizes the boundary fluctuations across different length scales, which can reveal information about a material''s pinning landscape and collective interfacial behaviour. Finite sampling and image resolution can bias the measured scaling properties, however. These effects can particularly complicate comparisons between circular domains of different sizes, where the number of resolved boundary points, and the relationship between angular and physical separations vary with the interface radius. Here, we benchmark the recovery of the roughness exponent and amplitude using synthetic self-affine interfaces generated by Fourier synthesis, mapped onto circular contours, and rasterized onto a pixel grid. We first compare displacement-correlation (B(r)) and structure-factor (S(q)) estimates for different interface lengths. To address non-uniform angular and radial spacing in a circular interface, we assess a reconstruction procedure that weights slope minimization against medial interface position. We find that while spectral estimates were most effective in the original interfaces, this advantage did not persist after circular mapping. Moderate smoothing was found to improve parameter recovery, but stronger smoothing can bias both the scaling exponent and roughness amplitude. These results, verified on both synthetic datasets, and an experimental ferroelectric system, identify limitations of circular-interface roughness measurements and provide a basis for further investigations into the evolution of circular domains under finite resolution experiments.

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”补充训练/验证集，再比较《以有限分辨率测量准圆形界面的粗糙度》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Monotonic probes of asymmetry and robustness of the quantum Mpemba effect
full_list.title_zh: 量子 Mpemba 效应的不对称性和鲁棒性的单调探针
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.34853v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Entanglement asymmetry has emerged as a powerful probe of symmetry restoration and the quantum Mpemba effect. However, its conventional Rényi generalizations, defined as differences of Rényi entropies, are not monotones in the resource-theoretic sense. Here, we investigate an alternative family of asymmetry quantifiers based on sandwiched Rényi divergences, which satisfy monotonicity under symmetry-preserving quantum channels. Developing a two-parameter replica approach, we show how these quantities can be computed from charged moments and establish a remarkable correspondence with conventional Rényi asymmetries under the inversion of the Rényi index, α↔ 1/α. This relation, exact for pure states, holds at leading order in the relevant scaling limits for homogeneous quantum quenches, including interacting integrable systems, and for Haar-random states. Applying these results to quenches from tilted ferromagnetic states, we demonstrate that the quantum Mpemba effect is remarkably robust, occurring throughout the entire family of sandwiched Rényi asymmetry monotones. We identify dynamical regimes in quenches from spatially inhomogeneous initial states where conventional Rényi asymmetries and genuine monotones exhibit qualitatively different behaviours. We also investigate a solvable toy model illustrating the possible dependence of Mpemba crossings on the Rényi index. Our findings establish a connection between conventional Rényi asymmetries and quantum resource theory, explaining their effectiveness in broad classes of nonequilibrium protocols while highlighting the additional information provided by genuine asymmetry monotones.
full_list.abstract_zh: 纠缠不对称性已成为对称性恢复和量子姆彭巴效应的有力探针。然而，其传统的 Rényi 概括（定义为 Rényi 熵的差异）在资源理论意义上并不是单调的。在这里，我们研究了基于夹层 Rényi 散度的另一类不对称量词，它满足对称性保持量子通道下的单调性。通过开发一种双参数复制方法，我们展示了如何从带电矩计算这些量，并在 Rényi 指数的反演 α↔ 1/α 下与传统的 Rényi 不对称性建立显着的对应关系。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 纠缠不对称性已成为对称性恢复和量子姆彭巴效应的有力探针。然而，其传统的 Rényi 概括（定义为 Rényi 熵的差异）在资源理论意义上并不是单调的。在这里，我们研究了基于夹层 Rényi 散度的另一类不对称量词，它满足对称性保持量子通道下的单调性。通过开发一种双参数复制方法，我们展示了如何从带电矩计算这些量，并在 Rényi 指数的反演 α↔ 1/α 下与传统的 Rényi 不对称性建立显着的对应关系。这种关系对于纯态来说是精确的，在同质量子猝灭（包括相互作用的可积系统）和哈尔随机态的相关标度极限中保持领先顺序。将这些结果应用于倾斜铁磁态的淬灭，我们证明量子 Mpemba 效应非常强大，发生在整个夹层 Rényi 不对称单调家族中。我们从空间不均匀的初始状态中识别淬灭的动力学机制，其中传统的 Rényi 不对称性和真正的单调表现出性质不同的行为。我们还研究了一个可解的玩具模型，说明 Mpemba 交叉点对 Rényi 指数的可能依赖性。我们的研究结果建立了传统 Rényi 不对称性和量子资源理论之间的联系，解释了它们在广泛的非平衡协议中的有效性，同时强调了真正的不对称单调提供的附加信息。

full_list.title_en: Multiscale Numerical Modelling of Ultrafast Laser-Matter Interactions: Maxwell Two Temperature Model Molecular Dynamics (M-TTM-MD)
full_list.title_zh: 超快激光与物质相互作用的多尺度数值模拟：麦克斯韦二温模型分子动力学 (M-TTM-MD)
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2601.20763v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this work, we present a comprehensive numerical framework that couples numerical solutions of Maxwell's equations using the Finite-Difference Time-Domain (FDTD) approach, Molecular Dynamics (MD), and the Two-Temperature Model (TTM) to describe ultrafast laser-matter interactions in metallic systems at the atomic scale. The proposed Maxwell-Two-Temperature Model-Molecular Dynamics (M-TTM-MD) bridges the gap between electromagnetic field propagation, electron-phonon energy exchange, and atomic motion, allowing for a self-consistent treatment of energy absorption, transport, and structural response within a unified simulation environment. The calculated electromagnetic fields incorporate dispersive dielectric properties derived using the Auxiliary Differential Equation (ADE) technique, while the electronic and lattice subsystems are dynamically coupled through spatially and temporally resolved energy exchange terms. The changes in the material topography are then reflected in the updated grid for the FDTD scheme. The developed M-TTM-MD model provides a self-consistent numerical framework that offers insights into laser-induced phenomena in metals, including energy transport and surface dynamics under extreme nonequilibrium conditions.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了一个全面的数值框架，该框架使用时域有限差分（FDTD）方法、分子动力学（MD）和双温度模型（TTM）耦合麦克斯韦方程组的数值解，以描述原子尺度金属系统中的超快激光-物质相互作用。提出的麦克斯韦双温度模型分子动力学（M-TTM-MD）弥合了电磁场传播、电子声子能量交换和原子运动之间的差距，允许在统一的模拟环境中对能量吸收、传输和结构响应进行自洽处理。

full_list.title_en: Nitrogen-Vacancy Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy of ¹⁵N Spins in Potassium Nitrite Solution
full_list.title_zh: 亚硝酸钾溶液中 15N 自旋的氮空位核磁共振谱
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.33360v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Nitrogen is essential in agricultural fertilizers, yet its nanoscale interfacial dynamics remain largely unexplored. Although quadrupolar broadening complicates ¹⁴N nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) detection, ¹⁵N (I=1/2) provides well-defined nuclear-spin signatures but remains challenging to detect at the nanoscale due to its low natural abundance and small gyromagnetic ratio. Here, we use a microfluidic quantum sensing platform based on shallow nitrogen vacancy (NV) centers in diamond to detect ¹⁵N NMR from KNO₃ solution at room temperature and in a low magnetic field regime. Within femtoliter-scale sensing volumes, we measure a magnetic-field variance of up to ~442 nT², ~43 times greater than the expected statistical polarization. The ¹⁵N spin correlation decays within ~500 mus, mainly limited by the NV spin lattice relaxation time and not by the molecular diffusion of the KNO₃ molecules. This is consistent with the formation of a KNO₃ adsorption layer on the diamond surface, supported by surface characterization.

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
